_comment: Hand edits for ranks 5001-10000 of the Russian deck (tools/extend_deck_russian.py). Keys are lemmas. {"drop": true} removes a lemma from the extension; {"gloss": "..."} replaces the automatic gloss (and bypasses the vulgar/form-of filters). Only the extension (ranks 5001+) is affected; the first 5,000 cards are never touched.

флагман.gloss: flagship; flag officer; (figuratively) leading company or product

профилактика.gloss: prevention, preventive measures, prophylaxis; maintenance, servicing

силовик.gloss: member of the security services or armed forces; (politics) silovik
